added_lines: Today we reported our Q4 and full-year FY'26 results.
In Q4, we delivered Total Revenues of $1,349.0M, Cloud Revenues of $503.0M up 6.0% Y/Y, $155.7M Net Income, $506.7M Adj. EBITDA dollars, $185.8M Operating Cash Flow, and $122.0M in Free Cash Flow.

We also announced our FY'27 outlook and focused on core organic growth in constant currency - driven by our expanded sales capacity, deepening our partner ecosystem, and investing in R&D across our portfolio, cloud capabilities, and AI offerings.
We are proud to join the
's AI Leadership Table and collaborate with leaders across industries, academia, and government to help advance AI adoption, workforce readiness, and innovation in Canada.
Looking forward to helping shape Canada's AI future together.
Canada has long been a leader in AI research and innovation.
Our future competitiveness depends on how effectively organizations adopt new technologies and develop the talent to use them.
As a global leader in enterprise AI and information management,
is joining BHER at a pivotal moment. Under the leadership of
, OpenText will help shape BHER's AI Leadership Table, bringing deep expertise to national efforts to strengthen AI adoption, workforce readiness, and productivity.
Together, BHER and OpenText will help strengthen the talent and innovation capacity needed for Canada to compete and lead in the AI economy.
